       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users_created,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue

WITH order_dates AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT od.user_id, od.order_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY od.user_id ORDER BY od.order_date) AS rn
  FROM order_dates od
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = od.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook' AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MIN(order_date) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS first_order,
         MIN(order_date) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot
WHERE second_order IS NOT NULL

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT u.id, DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS month, u.created_at,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi
      WHERE oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    ) AS converted
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, AVG(converted::int)::numeric AS share, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM cohort
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_time END) AS third_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT p.user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.third_order - p.second_order))/86400.0 AS days_diff
  FROM pivot p
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = p.user_id
  WHERE p.second_order IS NOT NULL AND p.third_order IS NOT NULL
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM diffs

filtered AS (

ranked AS (
  SELECT ot.user_id, ot.order_id, ot.order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ot.user_id ORDER BY ot.order_time) AS rn
  FROM order_times ot
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = ot.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_order,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN u.id END) AS converted, ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN u.id END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id),0)), 4) AS share FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, o.order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = o.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS t2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_time END) AS t3
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t3-t2))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot
WHERE t2 IS NOT NULL AND t3 IS NOT NULL

WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend) AS p90
FROM per_user

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT o.user_id, o.order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = o.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Organic' AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_order,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) = 1
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time, SUM(sale_price) AS order_value
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) -
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn > 1) AS median_diff
FROM ranked

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
firsttwo AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(order_date) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS first_order,
    MAX(order_date) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS second_order,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS p95_days
FROM firsttwo
WHERE cnt = 2

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
users_search AS (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE traffic_source = 'Search' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT r.user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN users_search us ON us.id = r.user_id
  GROUP BY r.user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot
WHERE second_order IS NOT NULL
